title.zh: ImportYeti 实测：如何从海运记录反查品牌供应商
title.en: ImportYeti hands-on: researching suppliers through shipment records

summary.zh: 我们实际搜索 Patagonia，查看企业进口概览、供应商名单、出货次数和商品 HS Code，验证 ImportYeti 在供应商背景调查中的用途。
summary.en: We searched for Patagonia and reviewed its import overview, supplier list, shipment counts and product HS codes to test ImportYeti for supplier research.

zh: 本次测试使用 ImportYeti 无需登录的公开查询功能。我们以 Patagonia 为例，仅查看公开海运进口记录，没有注册账号、下载数据或提交个人信息。
页面数据会持续更新，文章中的数字和界面以 2026 年 11 月 19 日实际测试时为准。
en: This test used ImportYeti's public search without signing in. We used Patagonia as an example and only viewed public sea-import records; no account was created and no personal information was submitted.
The service updates its records over time. Numbers and interface details in this guide reflect the live test on November 19, 2026.

heading.en: Step 1: Search for a target company

zh: 在首页输入 Patagonia 后，结果页同时列出公司和供应商身份，并展示总出货次数、最近一次出货日期及关联名称。先确认公司地址和类型，可以减少同名企业造成的误判。
en: After entering Patagonia, the results page showed both company and supplier profiles, along with total shipments, latest shipment dates and related names. Checking the company type and address first helps avoid selecting a similarly named business.

alt.zh: ImportYeti 搜索 Patagonia 后的真实结果页面
alt.en: Live ImportYeti search results for Patagonia

caption.zh: 真实操作截图：搜索结果包含企业类型、地址、总出货次数和最近出货时间。
caption.en: Live test screenshot: results include company type, address, total shipments and latest shipment date.

heading.zh: 第二步：查看进口活动概览

zh: 进入企业详情后，可以看到最近出货时间、海运记录总量、平均 TEU 和估算运输支出。趋势图适合判断采购是否具有季节性，但估算值只能作为调查线索，不能替代企业提供的正式数据。
en: The company profile shows the latest shipment, total sea shipments, average TEU and estimated shipping spend. The timeline can help identify seasonality, but estimates should be treated as research signals rather than official company figures.

alt.zh: ImportYeti 的 Patagonia 企业进口活动概览

caption.zh: 真实操作截图：企业详情页展示进口活动指标和时间趋势。
caption.en: Live test screenshot: the company page shows import metrics and shipment trends.

heading.zh: 第三步：分析供应商和商品线索
heading.en: Step 3: Analyze suppliers and product signals

zh: 供应商表格列出了供应商名称、所在国家、出货次数、商品描述和 HS Code。实务中可以用出货次数判断合作活跃度，再用商品描述和 HS Code 筛选与自己品类相关的工厂。
这些记录只能证明公开提单中出现过相关关系，不代表当前仍在合作，也不等于供应商已经通过质量、合规或交付能力审核。联系供应商前仍需独立验厂和资质核验。
en: The supplier table lists supplier names, countries, shipment counts, product descriptions and HS codes. Shipment frequency can indicate activity, while product descriptions and HS codes help narrow the list to factories relevant to a product category.

These records only show relationships found in public bills of lading. They do not prove a current partnership or validate quality, compliance or delivery capability. Independent due diligence is still required before contacting or selecting a supplier.

alt.zh: ImportYeti 中 Patagonia 的供应商分析表

caption.zh: 真实操作截图：供应商列表显示国家、出货次数、商品描述和 HS Code。
caption.en: Live test screenshot: the supplier list shows countries, shipment counts, product descriptions and HS codes.

zh: ImportYeti 适合用于美国进口商和供应商关系的初步调查，尤其适合寻找同类品牌的供应链线索。它不能替代供应商审核，也不覆盖所有运输方式和所有国家，因此更适合作为供应商发现流程的第一步。
en: ImportYeti is useful for early-stage research into US importers and supplier relationships, especially when looking for supply-chain leads from comparable brands. It does not replace supplier verification and does not cover every shipping mode or country, so it works best as the first step in a sourcing workflow.

sources.label: U.S. Customs and Border Protection ACE

category.zh: 电动自行车 B2B · 欧盟合规

title.zh: 欧盟电助力自行车进入市场：电动车贸易商要准备的 4 道合规关卡
title.en: Entering the EU e-bike market: four compliance gates for e-bike traders

summary.zh: 基于欧盟截至 2026 年 11 月的法规原文，梳理 250W/25km/h 分类边界、2027 年机械法规切换、LMT 电池护照和线上产品信息要求，并转化为电动车贸易商可执行的资料清单。
summary.en: Using EU legal texts current to November 2026, this guide maps the 250W/25km/h classification boundary, the 2027 machinery-law transition, LMT battery passports and online product information into an actionable checklist for e-bike traders.

heading.zh: 先说结论：合规不是一张证书，而是一条证据链
heading.en: The core idea: compliance is an evidence chain, not one certificate

zh: 对出口欧盟的电助力自行车，产品分类、整车机械安全、电池要求、线上信息和欧盟经济运营商责任相互连接。单独拿到一份测试报告，并不能证明具体 SKU、当前配置、说明书、标签和销售页面都处于一致状态。
本文是截至 2026 年 11 月 19 日的业务研究，不是法律意见。欧盟法规仍可能通过实施法案、协调标准清单和成员国执行规则继续更新；正式上市前应让欧盟进口商、合规负责人和具备对应范围的实验室复核每个 SKU。
en: For an e-bike entering the EU, vehicle classification, machinery safety, battery rules, online information and the responsibilities of EU economic operators form one connected chain. A single test report does not prove that a specific SKU, its current configuration, instructions, labels and sales page remain aligned.

This is business research verified on November 19, 2026, not legal advice. Implementing acts, harmonised-standard lists and Member State enforcement can continue to change; the EU importer, responsible operator and a properly scoped laboratory should review every SKU before market launch.

heading.zh: 关卡一：先锁定 250W/25km/h 的车辆分类边界

zh: 欧盟法规 168/2013 第 2(2)(h) 条把一类脚踏助力自行车排除在该法规的机动车型式批准范围之外：最大连续额定功率不超过 250W；骑手停止踩踏时电机停止输出；助力随速度逐渐降低，并在达到 25km/h 之前切断。这里应核对的是整车控制逻辑和最大连续额定功率，而不只是网页上的营销名称。
满足这条排除条件不等于自动完成全部欧盟合规。它只解决 168/2013 的范围判断，整车仍需处理适用的机械安全、其他产品法规、标签、技术文件和销售国要求。超过边界的车型可能进入 L 类车辆体系，应在报价和样品确认之前单独分类，不能与普通 EPAC 共用一套声明。
en: Article 2(2)(h) of Regulation 168/2013 excludes a defined pedal-assist cycle from that Regulation's motor-vehicle type-approval scope: maximum continuous rated power no greater than 250W, motor output stopping when the cyclist stops pedalling, and assistance progressively reducing and cutting off before 25km/h. The control behaviour and continuous rating matter—not merely the marketing name shown on a product page.

Meeting this exclusion does not complete EU compliance. It only answers the scope question under Regulation 168/2013; machinery safety, other applicable product rules, labels, technical documentation and destination-country rules still need to be addressed. Models outside the boundary may fall into an L-category vehicle route and should not share one declaration with a standard EPAC.

alt.zh: EUR-Lex 上欧盟法规 168/2013 关于 250W 和 25km/h 电助力自行车的原文
alt.en: EUR-Lex text of Regulation 168/2013 covering the 250W and 25km/h pedal-assist boundary

caption.zh: 真实网页截图：法规原文同时限定连续额定功率、踩踏联动和 25km/h 前切断助力。
caption.en: Live webpage screenshot: the legal text combines continuous rated power, pedalling behaviour and assistance cut-off before 25km/h.

heading.zh: 关卡二：为 2027 年机械法规切换准备双时间线
heading.en: Gate 2: prepare a two-timeline plan for the 2027 machinery transition

zh: 欧盟委员会说明，2027 年 1 月 20 日之前投放欧盟市场的机械产品仍必须符合机械指令 2006/42/EC；机械法规 (EU) 2023/1230 从 2027 年 1 月 20 日起强制适用。对于在 2026 年末开发、但可能在 2027 年后出货的车型，电动车贸易商不应只按下单日期判断，而应与进口商确认具体的“投放市场”时间和适用法规。
协调标准是证明符合基本安全要求的一种自愿路径，其引用需要在欧盟官方公报中发布。实际做法是为每个 SKU 建立一张法规—风险—测试—证据矩阵，并让实验室确认当前适用的标准版本和新旧机械法规过渡安排，而不是把一张历史测试证书直接复制到新配置。
en: The European Commission states that machinery placed on the EU market before January 20, 2027 must comply with Directive 2006/42/EC, while Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 becomes mandatory from January 20, 2027. For models developed in late 2026 but shipped after the transition, e-bike traders should agree with the importer on the actual placing-on-the-market date rather than relying only on the order date.

Harmonised standards are a voluntary route for demonstrating conformity with essential requirements, and their references must be published in the Official Journal. In practice, each SKU needs a legislation–risk–test–evidence matrix, with a laboratory confirming the current standard editions and transition plan instead of reusing an old certificate for a changed configuration.

heading.zh: 关卡三：把电池当成独立的数据产品管理
heading.en: Gate 3: manage the battery as a separate data product

zh: 欧盟电池法规把电动自行车和电动滑板车电池归入轻型交通工具电池（LMT battery）。欧盟委员会概述的规则覆盖可持续性、安全、标签、供应链尽职调查和报废管理，而不是只有运输测试。
法规第 77 条规定，从 2027 年 2 月 18 日起，每个投放市场或投入使用的 LMT 电池都应具有电子电池护照，并通过唯一标识关联数据。电动车贸易商应把准备工作前移到电芯和电池包供应商：先建立型号、化学体系、容量、制造工厂、合规声明、状态与寿命参数、维修拆解信息和责任人的字段字典，再评估未来 QR 码和电池护照由谁创建、更新和保存。
不要等到客户要求二维码时才开始补数据。更稳妥的采购条款是把法规所需数据、变更通知、批次追溯和持续更新责任写进电池供应协议，并确保更换电芯、BMS 或壳体后触发重新评估。
en: The EU Batteries Regulation classifies e-bike and e-scooter batteries as light means of transport (LMT) batteries. The Commission's overview spans sustainability, safety, labelling, supply-chain due diligence and end-of-life management—not only transport testing.

Article 77 requires each LMT battery placed on the market or put into service from February 18, 2027 to have an electronic battery passport linked to a unique identifier. E-bike traders should move preparation upstream: define fields for battery model, chemistry, capacity, manufacturing plant, declarations, state-of-health and lifetime parameters, repair and dismantling information, and accountable owners; then decide who creates, updates and retains the passport and QR-linked data.

Waiting for a customer to request a QR code is too late. Supplier agreements should cover required data, change notification, batch traceability and ongoing updates, with changes to cells, BMS or enclosure triggering reassessment.

alt.zh: EUR-Lex 上欧盟电池法规第 77 条 LMT 电池护照原文
alt.en: Article 77 of the EU Batteries Regulation on LMT battery passports in EUR-Lex

caption.zh: 真实网页截图：第 77 条明确 2027 年 2 月 18 日起 LMT 电池需要电子电池护照。
caption.en: Live webpage screenshot: Article 77 sets the electronic battery-passport requirement for LMT batteries from February 18, 2027.

heading.zh: 关卡四：让产品页成为合规证据链的一部分
heading.en: Gate 4: make product pages part of the compliance evidence chain

zh: 欧盟通用产品安全法规第 19 条要求，面向欧盟消费者的线上或远程销售要约清晰展示制造商名称及邮政和电子地址；制造商不在欧盟时还要展示欧盟责任人的名称及联系方式；同时提供产品图片、型号或其他识别信息，以及适用的警告和安全信息。
B2B 电动车网站应先判断产品页面究竟是询盘展示，还是已经构成面向欧盟消费者的销售要约。即使页面只服务经销商，也建议建立可复用的“经销商合规资料包”，让客户能准确发布型号、制造商、欧盟责任人、警告、说明书版本和产品图片，减少下游自行复制错误信息。
en: Article 19 of the General Product Safety Regulation requires online or distance-sales offers aimed at EU consumers to clearly show the manufacturer's name and postal and electronic address; where the manufacturer is outside the EU, the EU responsible person's name and contact details; product identification including an image and type or other identifier; and applicable warnings and safety information.

B2B e-bike websites should first determine whether each page is an enquiry showcase or an offer targeted at EU consumers. Even for distributor-only pages, a reusable dealer compliance pack can help customers publish the correct model, manufacturer, EU responsible person, warnings, instruction revision and images instead of retyping inconsistent data.

heading.zh: 给电动车贸易商：一周内可以完成的检查清单
heading.en: For e-bike traders: a one-week action checklist

zh: 第一，给现有车型建立分类表：连续额定功率、最高助力速度、停止踩踏后的输出逻辑、油门或助推功能、目标国家和预定投放时间。任何一项超出普通 EPAC 边界时，单独升级评审。
第二，为每个 SKU 建立版本化证据包：BOM 与关键部件版本、风险评估、测试报告、符合性声明、标签、说明书、产品照片、序列号规则和变更记录。要求销售报价单引用明确的 SKU 与资料包版本。
第三，向电池供应商发一份 2027 数据问卷，确认电池护照字段、唯一标识、数据所有者、更新接口、可拆卸与更换方案、批次追溯和变更通知能力。把无法提供的数据标为供应链缺口，而不是网站文案问题。
第四，抽查企业产品页和提供给经销商的素材包，检查型号是否唯一、规格是否与测试样品一致、是否存在“250W”与控制器或峰值功率表述混淆、警告和说明书版本是否可追溯。每月记录缺口关闭率、供应商资料按时率和配置变更后的重新评估周期。
en: First, create a classification sheet for every model: continuous rated power, maximum assisted speed, output behaviour when pedalling stops, throttle or walk-assist functions, target country and intended placing-on-the-market date. Escalate any model outside the standard EPAC boundary for a separate review.

Second, build a versioned evidence pack per SKU: BOM and critical-component revisions, risk assessment, test reports, declaration of conformity, labels, instructions, product photographs, serial-number rules and change history. Sales quotations should reference a defined SKU and evidence-pack revision.

Third, send battery suppliers a 2027 data questionnaire covering passport fields, unique identifiers, data ownership, update interfaces, removability and replacement design, batch traceability and change notification. Treat missing data as a supply-chain gap rather than a copywriting problem.

Fourth, sample-check company product pages and dealer media packs for unique model identification, alignment with the tested sample, confusion between the 250W continuous rating and controller or peak-power claims, and traceable warning and instruction revisions. Track gap-closure rate, on-time supplier data and reassessment lead time after configuration changes each month.

sources.label: European Commission — Machinery legislation and 20 January 2027 transition
European Commission — Harmonised standards for machinery
EUR-Lex — General Product Safety Regulation, consolidated 29 May 2026

category.zh: 电动自行车 B2B · 供应商变更管理

title.zh: 样品通过后仍会出问题：电动车贸易商如何管住供应商变更
title.en: Why approved samples still fail: supplier change control for e-bike traders

summary.zh: 从 Bosch、ZF 与 PPG 的公开供应商质量资料中提炼一套适合电动自行车项目的变更通知流程，把电池、控制器、固件、材料、工厂和二级供应商变化纳入可追溯的批准闭环。
summary.en: Public supplier-quality materials from Bosch, ZF and PPG are translated into a practical change-notification workflow for e-bike projects, covering batteries, controllers, firmware, materials, factories and sub-tier suppliers.

heading.zh: 样品批准只是建立基线，不是永久保证
heading.en: Sample approval creates a baseline, not a permanent guarantee

zh: 电动自行车样品通过测试后，量产风险仍可能来自未经确认的变化：电芯或 BMS 替换、控制器参数调整、固件升级、刹车或前叉换厂、车架材料或焊接工艺改变、生产线搬迁，以及二级供应商更换。单个零件看似等效，组合到整车后却可能影响续航、制动、热管理、EMC、耐久性、标签或原有测试结论。
因此，采购合同中的规格书只是静态基线，还需要一套动态的变更通知与批准机制。核心原则是：供应商在实施前说明变化，采购方按风险决定需要文件审查、样品、局部验证还是重新测试，并能够识别首批变更产品。
en: Even after an e-bike sample passes testing, production risk can arise from unreviewed changes: a new cell or BMS, controller tuning, firmware updates, a different brake or fork factory, changes to frame material or welding, a line transfer, or a sub-tier supplier replacement. A part may look equivalent in isolation yet alter range, braking, thermal behaviour, EMC, durability, labelling or the validity of earlier test evidence when integrated into the bicycle.

A purchasing specification is therefore a static baseline, not a complete control system. Suppliers should describe changes before implementation; the buyer should use risk to decide whether document review, samples, partial validation or retesting is needed; and the first changed production lot should remain identifiable.

heading.zh: 公开供应商资料说明：成熟采购体系会把变更单独管理
heading.en: Public supplier documents show that mature buyers manage change separately

zh: Bosch 的公开供应商页面把 Mobility 的供应商质量要求、新产品可行性确认、部件供应链图和变更管理分开列出，并提供 SICR 供应商变更请求流程手册与 Change Proposal Form。这里的重要启发不是照搬某家公司的表格，而是把新产品批准、供应链透明度和量产变更当作相互衔接但不同的控制环节。
对电动车贸易商而言，询价阶段就应要求关键部件的制造商、料号和版本；样品批准时冻结基线；量产期间则通过变更请求重新评估。否则，采购团队只知道整车供应商名称，却无法判断电池包、控制器或制动系统的下级来源是否已经变化。
en: Bosch's public supplier page separates Mobility supplier quality requirements, new-product feasibility, the component supply-chain chart and change management, and provides a supplier manual for its SICR process plus a Change Proposal Form. The lesson is not to copy one company's forms, but to treat new-product approval, supply-chain visibility and serial-production changes as connected yet distinct controls.

E-bike traders can request the maker, part number and revision of critical components during quotation, freeze that baseline at sample approval, and use a change request for later reassessment. Without that sequence, the purchasing team may know the bicycle assembler while remaining blind to changes in the battery pack, controller or braking system below tier one.

alt.zh: Bosch 供应商页面中 Mobility 质量文件和变更管理资料
alt.en: Bosch supplier page showing Mobility quality and change-management documents

caption.zh: 真实网页截图：Bosch 将供应商质量要求、部件供应链图和 SICR 变更管理资料分别列出。
caption.en: Live webpage screenshot: Bosch lists supplier quality requirements, the component supply-chain chart and SICR change-management materials as separate resources.

heading.zh: 先定义哪些变化必须报，再讨论提前多久
heading.en: Define reportable changes before debating notice periods

zh: 一份可执行的触发清单至少应覆盖：设计与规格、原材料、关键部件制造商或料号、固件和控制参数、工艺和检验方法、模具与设备、生产地点、二级供应商、包装与标签，以及法规或认证状态。对电池、BMS、控制器、显示器和传感器等电子部件，还要把芯片停产替代、软件版本和测试程序变化写入通知范围。
ZF 的公开 QD83 页面既列出通用的产品或过程 Supplier Change Request，也为电子部件和软件设置 PCN 表单。这说明电子部件变更值得更细的字段与评估路径。具体表单和提前期必须由买卖双方合同、适用标准及风险等级确定，不能把某一家企业的要求误当成全行业法定期限。
en: A workable trigger list should cover design and specification, raw materials, critical-component maker or part number, firmware and control parameters, process and inspection methods, tooling and equipment, manufacturing location, sub-tier suppliers, packaging and labels, and regulatory or certification status. For cells, BMS units, controllers, displays and sensors, it should also cover end-of-life substitutions, software revisions and test-program changes.

ZF's public QD83 page lists a general Supplier Change Request for product or process and a separate PCN form for electronic components and software. That is a useful signal that electronics deserve more detailed fields and a tailored review path. The actual form and notice period must come from the parties' contract, applicable requirements and risk level; one company's supplier rule is not an industry-wide legal deadline.

alt.zh: ZF Supplier Board 上针对电子部件的产品和过程变更通知表单入口
alt.en: ZF Supplier Board entry for product and process change notification for electronic components

caption.zh: 真实网页截图：ZF QD83 为电子部件和软件列出专门的产品/过程变更通知与供应商变更请求表单。
caption.en: Live webpage screenshot: ZF QD83 lists a dedicated product/process change notification and supplier change request form for electronic components and software.

heading.zh: 把一张变更申请单变成四道批准闸门
heading.en: Turn one change request into four approval gates

zh: 第一道是完整性：记录当前与拟变更的料号、版本、工厂、二级供应商、变更原因、计划日期、受影响 SKU 和在库数量。第二道是影响分析：逐项判断安全、功能、可靠性、法规、认证、交期、成本、售后备件和已有库存是否受影响。第三道是验证计划：明确需要哪些图纸、BOM、风险分析、样品、对比测试、实验室确认和批准责任人。第四道是切换与追溯：批准后记录生效批次、序列号范围、首批标识、旧料处置和经销商资料更新。
PPG 的公开供应商质量手册提供了一个可参考的管理强度示例：其特定适用范围内要求供应商在计划变更前至少 90 天书面通知，并在获得书面同意前不得实施；原材料、工艺参数、设备、工厂、第三方制造、测试方法、监管状态和包装变化都在示例范围内。贸易商可以据此理解“提前通知加书面批准”的逻辑，但应自行约定适合电动车项目的提前期，而不是直接复制 90 天。
en: Gate one is completeness: capture the current and proposed part number, revision, factory, sub-tier supplier, reason, planned date, affected SKUs and inventory. Gate two is impact analysis across safety, function, reliability, regulation, certification, lead time, cost, service parts and stock. Gate three is a validation plan naming the drawings, BOM, risk analysis, samples, comparison tests, laboratory input and approvers required. Gate four controls cutover and traceability through the effective lot, serial-number range, first-lot identification, old-stock disposition and dealer-content updates.

PPG's public supplier quality manual illustrates the possible strength of this control within its stated scope: it requires written notice at least 90 days before a planned change and written consent before implementation, with examples including raw materials, process parameters, equipment, sites, third-party manufacturing, test methods, regulatory status and packaging. Traders can learn from the logic of advance notice plus written approval, but should negotiate a notice period suited to their own e-bike project rather than copying 90 days automatically.

heading.zh: 给电动车贸易商：一周内建立最小可用变更流程
heading.en: For e-bike traders: build a minimum viable change process in one week

zh: 先选一个在售车型，建立关键部件基线表：整车型号、BOM 版本、车架材料与工艺、电池电芯与 BMS、控制器硬件与固件、电机、显示器、刹车、前叉、充电器、标签和说明书版本。每一项记录制造商、料号、版本、生产地点和对应证据文件。
随后制作一页式 Supplier Change Request，至少包含变更前后对照、原因、受影响范围、风险、验证建议、切换日期和首批追溯方式；在采购订单或质量协议中写明哪些变化必须事前书面通知，未获批准不得切换。紧急缺料可走临时偏差流程，但要限定数量、批次和失效日期，不能用口头同意代替永久变更批准。
最后设置三个每月指标：未经批准的变更次数、供应商按期通知率、变更申请从提交到关闭的周期。若一个关键部件无法确认实际制造商、版本或下级来源，应把它列为供应链透明度缺口，优先补齐，而不是等到客诉后再追查。
en: Start with one live model and create a critical-component baseline: bicycle model, BOM revision, frame material and process, battery cells and BMS, controller hardware and firmware, motor, display, brakes, fork, charger, labels and instruction revision. Record the maker, part number, revision, production site and supporting evidence for each item.

Then create a one-page Supplier Change Request covering before-and-after details, reason, affected scope, risk, proposed validation, cutover date and first-lot traceability. State in the purchase order or quality agreement which changes need advance written notice and may not be implemented without approval. Emergency shortages can use a temporary deviation limited by quantity, lot and expiry date; verbal agreement should not become permanent approval by accident.

Finally track three monthly measures: unauthorised changes, on-time supplier notification and request-to-closure lead time. If the actual maker, revision or sub-tier source of a critical component cannot be confirmed, record it as a supply-chain visibility gap and close it before a complaint forces the investigation.
